blocks.text: The Bohol International Flower, Food, & Fashion Festival (BIFFF) 2026 brought together 27 international master florists and 28 Visayan and national fashion designers on November 12, 2026 at BE Grand Resort Bohol in Panglao, Bohol, transforming cultural heritage into contemporary expressions of fashion, floral artistry, and gastronomy. Anchored on the theme “Sacred Futures: A Celebration of Roots. A Vision of Tomorrow,” BIFFF 2026 highlighted how Bohol’s traditions and creative industries contribute to its identity as a cultural and tourism destination. The festival’s main showcase, the Sacred Futures Gala Runway, brought this theme to life through contemporary fashion interpretations of sacred imagery, […]...
